command: claude CLI 2.1.285 print mode (claude -p --model claude-opus-5-5 --effort high --tools '' --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config '{"mcpServers":{}}' --no-session-persistence --system-prompt <porting system prompt>, prompt file on stdin, run from an empty directory)
notes:
Fixed in this attempt:
- Scenario length-range: the XCTL at line 52 now passes WS-BIG as a String of 32767 spaces.
  WS-BIG is a plain PIC X(32767) item that no generated DTO describes, so rule 14 / #3989 applies.
  The previous attempt passed an 80-byte CaxbDfhcommarea with LENGTH 32767, which is the harness's
  "commarea bytes past what its DTO holds" divergence.

Defects of the original kept:
- The RESP of the XCTL at line 52 is never tested (unchecked_responses, field-tested).
  The report runs whenever control returns, which happens only on failure.
  Fix: IF WS-RESP NOT = DFHRESP(NORMAL) around the report.
- WS-BIGLEN = 32767 is outside 0..32763, so mode X (or any mode other than S or L, including a blank
  one) always fails with LENGERR, RESP2 11.
  The screen then shows "XCTL FAILED RESP=22 RESP2=11".
  Fix: pass LENGTH(80) with a version-2 COMMAREA.
- Mode L uses XCTL LENGTH(80) on the 10-byte WS-V1. It passes the 70 bytes of WS-NEIGHBOUR, which
  CAXB reads as V2-TIER, V2-BALANCE and V2-NOTE.
  Fix: build a real 80-byte CAV2 COMMAREA.
- The RECEIVE and the XCTLs at lines 44 and 48 code no RESP. A LENGERR on input longer than 20 bytes
  abends the task with AEIV, and a PGMIDERR abends it with AEI0.
  Fix: code RESP on those commands.

Facts contradicted: none found.
